records.title: Physiological training in Jordan.
records.evidence_note: The report covers 705 individuals and 43 documented reactions in 39 trainees. Tables I and II exhaust the recorded events. The methods classify mild and severe DCS as possible chamber reactions. The authors describe 48-hour follow-up and give no distinct count of completed follow-ups or staff exposures. Counts shown for the three individual training profiles may overlap.
